critical_steps: The full two-family weave has energy exactly the ambient squared norm.
A=B=3 are valid universal K-g-fusion bounds for K=I/2.
The printed deletion hypothesis holds with C=2 and ||K^dagger||^2=4.
The deleted family has zero energy on e1 while ||K*e1||^2=1/4.
Extending a deleted partition and subtracting its deleted energy gives the corrected lower bound A-C||K^dagger||^2.
integrity.proof_basis: Exact two-dimensional counterexample and a direct closed-range Moore--Penrose estimate.
integrity.unproved_limits: No optimal partition-sensitive deletion threshold is characterized.

limitations: The finding refutes the sufficient deletion criterion in Theorem 2.5 and supplies a corrected sufficient criterion.
No necessity or sharpness is asserted for the coarse deleted-energy constant C.
The correction concerns deletion stability and does not reassess unrelated results in the source.

title: A reciprocal pseudoinverse error in a woven \(K\)-\(g\)-fusion deletion theorem
